title: Golden Knights POV: Washington Commanders Salute to Service Jump
description: U.S. Army Parachute Team Golden Knights member Sgt. 1st Class Ben Hall captures a first-person view of his parachute jump into Northwest Stadium in Landover, Maryland, Nov. 8, 2026, during the Washington Commanders’ Salute to Service game against the Los Angeles Rams. The demonstration highlights the Golden Knights’ precision parachuting capabilities while honoring service members, veterans and military families as part of the NFL’s annual Salute to Service initiative. (U.S. Army video courtesy of Sgt. 1st Class Ben Hall)
credit: U.S. Army video courtesy of Sgt. 1st Class Ben Hall
